name: testmail.app Free
free_limit: 100 received test emails/month, unlimited users, email addresses and mailboxes, one random namespace, and 1-day message retention.
watch_out: New accounts begin with a 14-day trial and automatically downgrade to the ongoing Free plan; custom namespaces, longer retention and full API access are paid. Intended for side projects and email testing, not outbound transactional delivery.
